Overview

This feature service provides the water line network for Westbank First Nation. It supports viewing and managing water distribution assets within the community and includes core attribute information for each line feature.

Feature Layer

WFN Water Lines represents linear water infrastructure assets such as mains and related service lines. The layer includes identifying, asset, material, size, installation, status, ownership, location, and reference information that supports utility inventory and operational record keeping.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation area in the Regional District of Central Okanagan, British Columbia and is maintained by Westbank First Nations with hosting support from the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Utility asset inventory and records management
  • Water distribution planning and maintenance support
  • Operational reference for infrastructure mapping
  • Integration with other municipal or regional GIS utility datasets
